content: In the season of crisis, the wise build bridges while the foolish build dams.
author: African Proverbs
explanation: When hardship strikes, the instinct of fear is to construct dams—hoarding resources, barricading borders, and shutting out neighbors. But the dam only builds up catastrophic water pressure until it bursts. The wise build bridges, expanding communion and mutual survival.
practicalInsight: Build a bridge toward someone you have been estranged from today. Reach across the divide.
reflectionPrompt: Are your current instincts in this season of your life focused on building walls or building bridges?
